items.expected: State the model composition, electron count, charge, electronic description and relation to the experimental dimer. A bonding explanation needs electronic evidence beyond a bond length. If comparing deformations or fragments, keep composition, state, reference and constraints consistent and distinguish minima from saddles.

Establish a quantitative, physically sound molecular description of the observed metal–metal bonding using correct stoichiometry and a justified model. Full210-atom computation is not mandatory when a smaller representation demonstrably addresses the bounded claim.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Support the proposed electronic/structural explanation with discriminating evidence. Orbital, density, energetic or other justified analyses can qualify; no prescribed orbital labels, deformation grid or fragment charge partition is required.

Assess whether model truncation, state stability and relevant numerical/relativistic assumptions limit the interpretation. Claimed minima/saddles and energetic comparisons require evidence appropriate to their structural status.
